notes: CBL object no. Pap XXII; CBL title: "Papyrus fragments"; CBL 'Script type': "Hieroglyphic script; Hieratic script". Canvas: "Side 1". Side 1; cropped to the two inscribed fragments at the upper right of the mount, from the Lahun group which the CBL description dates to c. 1800 BC and says are written in hieratic. The two hieroglyphic Book of the Dead fragments on the same mount are excluded (used separately as a control).
